name: docker-hub-retention
description: Github action to delete old images from Docker Hub
author: Philip Lehmann

scripts.release:build: bun run lint && bun run build && bun run package
scripts.github:release: gh release create "$(npm version patch --git-tag-version=false)" -t Release -d=false -n "" -p=false
scripts.git:push: git push origin main && git push --tags
scripts.release: bun run release:build && bun run github:release && bun run git:commit && bun run git:push
